setting: Humans wake from cold-sleep on a salvaged world where three incompatible elder civilizations annihilated one another fighting over a substance that thinks back, and the only survivors are the dreams it left behind.

civs.name: the-tessellate
civs.trait: a single organism that grew cities as its own recursive body

civs.name: the-pale-cartographers
civs.trait: mapped futures and mined the ones they liked best

civs.name: the-nullborn
civs.trait: evolved to silence thought, blind to the danger they unleashed

civs.name: the-glasswrights
civs.trait: wove living machinery from their own grown organs
